app.title: Plate reader growth curve QC
app.summary: A person looks over a 96-well plate of growth curves, each well drawn as a small plot with its fitted logistic curve and marked when an automatic QC rule fires. They step through the flagged wells, open each one large with its fitted growth parameters, drop bad time points by clicking them so the fit recomputes, or exclude the whole well. A table of mean maximum growth rate by strain and drug concentration updates as wells are kept or excluded, and the kept wells' parameters are downloaded as a CSV.

task.text: Check each well's growth curve fit on a plate, drop bad points or wells, and export growth parameters for the wells that are kept.

data.text: Optical density time series from a plate reader, one per well of a 96-well plate laid out by strain and replicate in rows and drug concentration in columns, with media-only blanks.
data.item: a well on a 96-well plate with its OD600 readings every 15 minutes over 24 hours

stage.text: quality-checking growth curve fits from a plate-reader run, before comparing strains and drug doses

mechanism.text: Every well is fitted and checked on load and drawn as a small multiple on the plate layout with a shared axis; selecting a well opens its curve large, where clicking points drops them and refits, and every change updates the well, the header counts and the strain-by-concentration summary.

field.text: bacterial growth curve fitting from plate-reader optical density, in microbiology

workflow.name: fit a curve per well, check flagged wells, and export the kept fits

steps.here: the plate's OD600 readings are built in (seeded synthetic data); every well is fitted with a logistic curve and checked against QC rules on load

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: the plate shows all 96 wells as small plots on a shared 0 to 24 h, OD axis, with the fit overlaid, flagged wells outlined and marked, excluded wells faded, and header counts of flagged, excluded and dropped points

steps.step: step through items one at a time
steps.here: Next flagged well jumps to the next well where a QC rule fired and is not yet excluded

the selected well's curve is drawn large with the fit and a tangent at maximum rate, its lag, max rate, carrying capacity, baseline, R² and points used, and the QC rules it tripped (spike, blank grew, no growth without drug, poor fit)
clicking a point drops it or puts it back and the fit reruns; Exclude this well removes it from the summary and export; Put back restores all dropped points
a shaded table gives the mean maximum growth rate of the kept replicate wells for each strain at each concentration, noting n=1 or none left
Download kept wells (CSV) saves each kept well's growth parameters, dropped time points and flags

distinctive: the plate layout carries the design: strain in duplicate rows, a drug dilution series across columns, and a media-only blank column
QC rules are specific to growth assays: a spike from a bubble, a blank that grew (contamination), no growth without drug (missed well), and an R² cutoff
growth parameters (lag, maximum rate, carrying capacity) come from a logistic fit by Levenberg-Marquardt, with a no-growth case left unfitted
point-level and well-level exclusion are separate, and both flow into the summary and the export
the summary averages only kept replicates, so excluding a well visibly changes the dose-response pattern
